name: Platform Shell
_comment_depends_on: The shell mounts module UIs from source and proxies to module APIs, so an
absent module is a stage that does not render rather than a broken page.
Unlike a module's upstreams these are also BUILD inputs: a repo missing
from disk fails the import, not just a request. Listed so start.bat can
bring them up and so the failure names itself. In START order, M04 first:
scripts/modules.ps1 reads this list for start.bat and the HOME card, so
a module added here is started and checked without editing either.
